market_summary: Broad USD strength is driving synchronized aggressive liquidations across Gold, EUR, GBP, and BTC during the London/NY Overlap session. All 4 assets are trading far below their daily Value Areas, VWAPs, and EMA50 baselines, with ATR bands expanding downwards. However, across all charts, prices are currently stretched far below their -2 ATR lower envelopes and sitting immediately above key Session Lows, with forming bars displaying initial pause and mean-reversion wicks. Due to extended risk-reward profiles directly into structural low-liquidity pockets, all setups are placed on HOLD awaiting pullbacks toward VWAP/EMA baselines.

signals.rationale: Price is positioned far below VAL (3932.26) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH (-9.74) with negative slope (-0.66), confirming strong selling pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price trades well below downward-sloping VWAP (3945.21) and EMA50 (3933.90). Candles are extended below the lower ATR band (3877.55) after high-volume breakdown spikes (6 spikes). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price below Gamma Flip (3886.02) and rejecting Put Wall #2 (3874.01), maintaining momentum down toward Put Wall #1 (3819.45) and Session Low (3852.35). However, forming bar shows a short-term intraday pause/bounce right above session lows, making immediate short entry extended.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.1078) and well below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (-7,026) with a declining slope (-8,721.7). Market is in LONDON_NY_OVERLAP.
